answer: The cutler's wheel throws sparks from first light, and his blades are sold as far as the market town. Proof of cutler blade via grind pass tally — a blade the cutler grinds only after 17 blades run true, each blade honed by the cutler himself. The garden holds the whetstone the edge is finished on. The grove tempers each blade in oil before the grinding. The zephyr wraps the finished knives for the stall. To counterfeit his work takes 17 blades ground, 17 blades honed and 17 blades proved, two days at the wheel for blades that still dull on the first cut.
